x: It is hoped that the loss of Franz Stampfl will not have too adverse an effect on our coaching and that those of our Club Coaches and members who have been taking advantage of his advice and assistance, will retain what he has endeavoured to pass on to them.

Luxon and Ted Gaworski were included in Franz Stampfl's team against Oxford and Cambridge and did very well. At Woodford Peter Porter threw the hammer for a new Club record of 157' 7" and Ted Gaworski put up another Club record in the weight.
Last year we had to say good bye to Franz Stampfl whose assistance we have had for the past few years, he having taken an appointment in Australia.
The sad news for the Club, and British athletics, was the departure for Australia of Franz Stampfl who had coached Club members since his arrival from Austria in 1937.
